entries.message: Keep Up Next aligned with watch state and preserve TVDB identity.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Fix: Keep removed or unwatched TV shows out of Up Next, including stale provider and fallback entries.
Fix: Preserve selected TVDB identity in watch history and repair same-coordinate title-only episodes during Fix Match.
Tweak: Improve dismissed Up Next interactions and watch-date actions.

entries.message: Discover recommendations are now more personal and controllable.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Feature: Personalize recommendations from recent watch history.
Feature: Let users choose Don't recommend to remove unwanted movies and shows from the personalized rail.
Fix: Restore Jellyfin watched, resume, and rating imports against current API field rules.
Fix: Keep removed TV shows out of Up Next across all episodes and provider refreshes.
Fix: Hide Clear progress unless a resume item has a positive playback position.
Tweak: Keep recommendation exclusions saved across refreshes and browsers.
Tweak: Hide watched titles and improve poster recovery across Discover.
Tweak: Improve card metadata hierarchy, summary readability, and release-date presentation across personal lists.
